title: Web Development Intern
summary: Join our core engineering squad to develop responsive frontends, reusable UI component systems, and integrate production REST APIs across enterprise client applications and our in-house SaaS platforms.
about_role: At Vyomantra Technologies, our engineering interns build production software from week one. You will work alongside our senior full-stack developers to create responsive user interfaces, modular React components, and integrate production REST APIs.
responsibilities: Build modular, responsive UI components using React, Next.js, HTML5, and modern CSS/vanilla styling.
Integrate client-side state management with backend RESTful APIs.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness across all viewport sizes.
Participate in weekly code reviews and implement performance optimization best practices.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate Figma prototypes into clean pixel-perfect interfaces.
qualifications: Pursuing or completed B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines. Self-taught developers with strong GitHub portfolios are actively welcomed.
competencies: Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and responsive design principles.
Foundational hands-on experience with React.js or Next.js.
Understanding of REST APIs and JSON data exchange.
Familiarity with Git version control and GitHub workflows.

title: Python & Backend Engineering Intern
summary: Engineer high-concurrency microservices, write asynchronous REST endpoints in FastAPI, design relational database schemas, and integrate generative AI pipelines directly into business workflows.
about_role: Build high-throughput backend APIs, asynchronous workers, and database architectures powering enterprise clients and our retail SaaS engine StockMitra. Learn industry-level Python engineering.
responsibilities: Develop high-performance RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI or Django.
Design and maintain relational database tables, views, and migrations in PostgreSQL / MySQL.
Write automation pipelines and integrate external third-party SDKs and payment gateways.
Implement authentication mechanisms (JWT, session tokens) and security sanitization.
Work with Redis caching layers and message queues for asynchronous background tasks.
qualifications: Pursuing or completed Bachelor's in CS, IT, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical coding background.
competencies: Strong proficiency in core Python, OOP, and data structures.
Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, or Django frameworks.
Basic understanding of SQL queries and relational database design.
Interest in Docker containerization and cloud deployments.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
summary: Take full architectural ownership of end-to-end web products, from responsive React/Next.js interfaces to resilient Node.js and Python microservices backed by PostgreSQL and Docker.
about_role: Vyomantra Technologies is expanding its core engineering team. As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will bridge the gap between design fidelity and robust systems infrastructure.
responsibilities: Architect, implement, and maintain responsive web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Develop scalable backend APIs in Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Django).
Design relational and document database schemas (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB).
Ensure high code quality through unit testing, integration tests, and rigorous pull request reviews.
Configure CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, and monitoring instrumentation.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical industry experience (1–3+ years in full-stack web development).
competencies: Deep proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript, modern React, state management, and SSR/SSG concepts.
Solid experience writing production APIs in either Node.js or Python.
Hands-on proficiency with relational databases and query optimization.
Familiarity with Docker containerization and Linux server administration.

title: UI/UX & Product Designer
summary: Lead human-centered design for high-impact web software, enterprise SaaS applications, and interactive mobile apps with a meticulous eye for aesthetics, accessibility, and user delight.
about_role: Design is the strategic core of everything we engineer at Vyomantra. Transform complex business workflows into clean, intuitive wireframes, interactive prototypes, and scalable Figma design systems.
responsibilities: Design complete end-to-end user journeys, wireframes, user personas, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma.
Build, maintain, and evolve tokenized design systems, component libraries, and style guides.
Conduct user research, usability testing, and heat-map analyses to identify friction points.
Partner closely with frontend engineers to ensure design precision, fluid micro-interactions, and accessibility.
Create interactive motion prototypes to showcase micro-interactions and transitions.
qualifications: Degree or diploma in Design, HCI, Visual Arts, or Computer Science, or equivalent proven track record. Live portfolio is required.
competencies: Mastery of Figma: Auto-layout, component variants, interactive prototypes, variables, and dev mode.
Solid understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, color theory, dark mode interfaces, and glassmorphism.
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and flexbox/grid to communicate effectively with developers.
Experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or Lottie animation.

title: AI & Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Pioneer production AI architectures, autonomous agent workflows, fine-tuned LLM reasoning systems, and computer vision models deployed at enterprise scale.
about_role: Vyomantra Technologies is creating intelligent systems that transform how companies operate. Develop and deploy neural networks, vector search databases, and RAG microservices.
responsibilities: Architect and deploy scalable AI microservices with Python, FastAPI, and Docker.
Build resilient RAG pipelines using vector stores (Pinecone, Chroma, pgvector) and embedding models.
Fine-tune open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma) using LoRA / QLoRA for domain-specific automation.
Develop computer vision and OCR pipelines for automated invoice, receipt, and identity verification.
Implement model monitoring, drift detection, prompt evaluation frameworks, and latency optimization.
qualifications: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.S. in CS, Data Science, AI, or equivalent practical industry experience (1–3+ years). Freshers with standout Kaggle/open-source records welcomed.
competencies: Deep fluency in Python and data science stacks (NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen).
Experience building and deploying RESTful APIs via FastAPI and Docker.
Understanding of vector databases, similarity metrics, and prompt engineering.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
summary: Drive high-velocity customer acquisition, performance ad campaigns (Meta & Google), organic technical SEO ranking, and data-driven marketing funnels for B2B tech products and client growth.
about_role: Oversee end-to-end inbound marketing strategies. Manage paid ad budgets, execute on-page and technical SEO, write compelling copy, build conversion funnels, and analyze multi-touch attribution metrics.
responsibilities: Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Search/Display, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword research, backlink acquisition, and metadata optimization to drive organic rankings.
Create conversion-focused landing page copy, ad creatives, email outreach sequences, and case studies.
Track multi-channel funnels via Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and client CRM dashboards.
Continuously run A/B split tests on ad hooks, headlines, CTAs, and landing pages to boost conversion rates.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Applications, or equivalent proven digital marketing track record (1–2+ years experience).
competencies: Proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display).
Hands-on familiarity with SEO platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog).
Deep understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and user acquisition funnel metrics (CPA, CAC, ROAS).
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical value propositions clearly.
